name: p3b-keylog-entries-key-corrupted
note: R60Critic P3b (empirical green at 1408dd90): receipt.keylog.entries[0].key 'End' -> 'EndX' in the top-level r56 control-domain slice. The r60 narrow check re-derives the slice's identity (End, Backspace, last nonce character, Tab) and refuses the corrupted key under keylog-entry-mismatch.
